messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — HarborView's ramp yesterday showed p99 tail issues on /v1/generate. Baseline model is m-instruct-7b, QPS ~175, p95 ~680ms but p99 spikes ~1.5s during burst windows. Can we propose a conservative mitigation (quantization + routing) before their full integration test tomorrow?

aj_eng: Yep. Low-friction approach: (1) int8 canary of m-instruct-7b at small percent, (2) prefix-length routing to divert short prompts to a quantized/compact variant. Keep full-precision as immediate fallback.

tom_runtime: Also check KV cache hit rate — smoke shows cache_hit ~0.18 which exaggerates p99. If cache_hit < 0.3, diverting short prefixes helps latency without hurting hit reuse.

maria_cs: log snippet from smoke run:
```
harborview/smoke: qps=174 p50=108ms p95=680ms p99=1502ms cache_hit=0.18
```

sophie_customer: Our QA/legal asks: will int8/int4 materially change answers? They want acceptance criteria before we touch canary.

aj_eng: short answer: small risk. Proposed guardrails:
1) run targeted quality check on HarborView's top-250 prompts (automated heuristics + spot human review)
2) 12h canary at 3-5% with automated rollback if regression > 1%
3) human review gate if regression > HarborView threshold (they can set e.g., 1.25%)
I'll produce a diff artifact for their team.

maria_cs: I'll ask HarborView for top-250 samples and any strict QA checks they need.

tom_runtime: Draft routing policy to stage in Console:
```
rules:
  - when: prefix_tokens < 32
    model: m-instruct-7b-int8
    percent: 5
  - when: else
    model: m-instruct-7b
    percent: 95
fallback: m-instruct-7b
observe: [latency_p95, latency_p99, quality_regression_rate, cache_hit]
alerts:
  - expr: quality_regression_rate > 0.01
    action: rollback-canary
```
Note: int4 is attractive but depends on kernel/hardware support; prefer int8 initially for A10 fleets. I'll detect GPU family and attach kernel suggestion.

maria_cs: action items:
- aj_eng: run quick diffs + attach sample diffs/artifact (ETA 36h)
- tom_runtime: stage routing policy in Console and add alert hooks + dashboard link (ETA EOD)
- sophie_customer: fetch top-250 prompt samples and QA checklist from HarborView (ETA tomorrow morning)

sophie_customer: HarborView also asked for a user-tier override — gold users must always hit full model. Can we add that?

tom_runtime: yes. example rule with tier exception:
```
rules:
  - when: user_tier == "gold"
    model: m-instruct-7b
    percent: 100
  - when: prefix_tokens < 32
    model: m-instruct-7b-int8
    percent: 10
```

maria_cs: recommend presenting two options to HarborView: conservative (int8 + prefix routing + tier exceptions) vs aggressive (int4 + prefix routing). Recommend conservative for first canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled -> canary_id=4823456789-1 model=m-instruct-7b-int8 percent=5 region=us-west-2

aj_eng: initial eval summary (prelim): p95 down ~30% on perf set, token cost ~-18%, automated quality heuristics show ~0.5% drift. Will attach sampled diffs to the ticket.

maria_cs: great. once HarborView confirms samples we'll run the 12h 5% canary and invite their QA for live review. I'll include a short renewal note outlining ops changes, cost delta, and reversible plan. :thumbsup:

sophie_customer: HarborView sent prompts + QA rules. They require human review if post-canary quality_regression_rate > 1.25%. I'll subscribe them to the alert.

tom_runtime: watch rolling windows — cache_hit can change quickly after routing. If cache_hit improves, p99 should drop further. Also keep an eye on origin CPU.

maria_cs: thanks team. I'll post the console dashboard link once canary is steady and add the summary to the CSM renewal packet.
